d.title: Flashback Game
d.jp: フラッシュバックゲーム
d.synopsis: Mizuho, Noriko and Yuri are three friends that go to a beauty spa that Yuri won in a competition. They relax there and have fun until they try one of the new treatments, where they see un a shining light. This light bring back their traumatic memories such as rapes of squads and sexual abuse in childhood.
